assessment.diversity_evidence: All stories share the damaged-kite setup and use nearly the same short, repetitive language. Four stories (s000014, s000017, s000035, s000007, s000041) resolve it by taping and flying the kite; most others repurpose it as a boat sail (including s000058, s000023, s000034, s000002, s000024). Only s000036, s000021, s000039, and s000018 make the failed tape repair a consequential turn before the sail solution. Names and minor dialogue differences do not create new plots; these sample stories show limited variation, not the full generator’s range.
